Quick Start link

# Pull any of the 6 built-in encoder tags (fetches upstream BF16 Safetensors)
oflm pull bge-base:en-v1.5

# Or install a GGUF / Safetensors build of one of the 6 encoders (--name <tag>)
oflm add nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5-GGUF --name nomic-embed-text:v1.5

# Serve POST /v1/embeddings alongside a chat model
oflm serve llama3.2:1b --embed 1 --embeddingmodel bge-base:en-v1.5
oflm serve llama3.2:1b --embed 1 --embeddingmodel nomic-embed-text:v1.5 --prompt-name query

# Benchmark single and batched NPU throughput
oflm bench-embed bge-base:en-v1.5 --max-batch 128 --bench-iterations 3
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:52625/v1", api_key="oflm")
resp = client.embeddings.create(
 model="bge-base:en-v1.5",
 input=["First document chunk.", "Second document chunk."],
)
print(len(resp.data), len(resp.data[0].embedding))

Variants & Built-in Shortcuts link

Tag Variant Runtime & Format Sequence & RAM Status
Custom GGUF / Safetensors (oflm add --name <tag>) 22M–335M memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
all-minilm:l6-v2 22M 384d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
bge-small:en-v1.5 33M 384d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
bge-base:en-v1.5 109M 768d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
nomic-embed-text:v1.5 137M 768d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
gte-multilingual:base 305M 768d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
bge-large:en-v1.5 335M 1024d memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten512 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady

Tips & Current Limitations link

  • Supported encoder tags: The BERT embedding runtime dispatches to the 6 compiled encoder tags in the table above (all-minilm:l6-v2, bge-small:en-v1.5, bge-base:en-v1.5, nomic-embed-text:v1.5, gte-multilingual:base, and bge-large:en-v1.5), not arbitrary uncompiled BERT architectures. oflm pull <tag> fetches upstream BF16 Safetensors directly; when installing a custom GGUF or local Safetensors build with oflm add, pass --name <tag> so it registers under the matching encoder tag.
  • Quantization & loading: Q8_0 GGUF and upstream Safetensors checkpoints load with minimal startup overhead; OpenFlowLM converts BF16, F16, F32, Q6_K, Q5_K, Q4_K, and Q4_0 weights on first load.
  • NixOS package (.#oflm-with-bert): Source-built .#oflm on NixOS omits git-tracked src/xclbins (#244 ); build or install .#oflm-with-bert on NixOS to include the compiled open BERT NPU kernels.
  • Batched indexing & 512-token limit: Pass up to 128 strings per input array for single-pass batched NPU execution. oflm serve returns HTTP 400 for inputs over 512 tokens; use EmbeddingGemma for passages up to 2,048 tokens.
  • Nomic task prefixes (--prompt-name): nomic-embed-text:v1.5 expects a task prefix (query, document, clustering, or classification) via --prompt-name at server startup or prompt_name in the JSON request body.

 model="embed-gemma:300m",
 input="OpenFlowLM runs 2,048-token embeddings on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs.",
)

Variants & Built-in Shortcuts link

Tag Variant Runtime & Format Sequence & RAM Status
Custom GGUF / Safetensors (oflm add --name embed-gemma:300m) 300M 768d splitscreenNPU + CPUinfo deployed_codeGGUF layersSafetensors straighten2048 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady
embed-gemma:300m 300M 768d splitscreenNPU + CPUinfo deployed_codeGGUF straighten2048 tok 8 GB+ RAM check_circleReady

Tips & Current Limitations link

  • Built-in GGUF shortcut & --name embed-gemma:300m: oflm pull embed-gemma:300m already downloads ggml-org/embeddinggemma-300M-GGUF (Q8_0) directly. Because the embedding engine dispatches on the exact tag embed-gemma:300m, always pass --name embed-gemma:300m when registering a custom BF16, F16, or local Q8_0 checkpoint via oflm add.
  • NixOS CPU fallback (#244): EmbeddingGemma accelerates projections with prebuilt npu_matmul_f32 NPU kernels, which are omitted from source-built NixOS packages (#244 ); on NixOS, embed-gemma:300m falls back to CPU execution.
  • Single-query execution vs. bulk batching: EmbeddingGemma encodes one text sequence per pass, suiting interactive RAG queries and 2,048-token chunks. For bulk indexing of chunks under 512 tokens, use BERT Encoders for multi-item batching.
  • Task hints & Open WebUI setup: Pass prompt_name (such as query or document) in POST /v1/embeddings requests or --prompt-name at server launch. In Open WebUI (Server Mode ), open Admin Settings -> Documents, set Embedding Model Engine to OpenAI, URL http://127.0.0.1:52625/v1, API key oflm, and model embed-gemma:300m.

item.title: GPT-OSS
item.description:
Capabilities
chatChatpsychologyReasoning
Runtime & Format
historyClosed NPUinfohistoryLegacy Q4NX
Variants
20Bconstruction20B Open GGUF #91120B
Context & Quantization
straighten8K4-bit Fixed
construction
Open NPU Kernels & GGUF Support in Progress (#91): GPT-OSS 20B has no open NPU kernels on main yet (#91, #240 ), so oflm add does not accept GPT-OSS GGUF files. Because OpenFlowLM does not silently fall back to closed engines, pass OFLM_GPTOSS_ENGINE=closed to run the .q4nx shortcuts on Windows or Linux packages (omitted on source-built NixOS per #244 ).

Quick Start link

# Download the built-in 20B .q4nx shortcut
oflm pull gpt-oss:20b

# Run on Linux / macOS bash (explicit Closed NPU opt-in required)
OFLM_GPTOSS_ENGINE=closed oflm run gpt-oss:20b
# Run on Windows PowerShell (explicit Closed NPU opt-in required)
$env:OFLM_GPTOSS_ENGINE="closed"; oflm run gpt-oss:20b

# Inside interactive chat, set reasoning effort (low, medium, or high)
/set r-eff high

Variants & Built-in Shortcuts link

Tag Variant Runtime & Format Context & RAM Status
Custom GGUF (oflm add) 20B memoryNPU deployed_codeGGUF straighten8K 64 GB+ RAM constructionWIP #91 constructionGGUF #240
gpt-oss:20b 20B historyClosed NPUinfo historyLegacy Q4NX straighten8K 64 GB+ RAM constructionOpen NPU #91 constructionNixOS #244
gpt-oss-sg:20b 20B historyClosed NPUinfo historyLegacy Q4NX straighten8K 64 GB+ RAM constructionOpen NPU #91 constructionNixOS #244

Tips & Current Limitations link

  • Closed NPU opt-in & NixOS (#244): Both built-in 20B shortcuts download pre-quantized (~14.0 GB on disk; 120B is not supported) and require OFLM_GPTOSS_ENGINE=closed. Source-built NixOS packages omit prebuilt closed NPU binaries (#244 ), so GPT-OSS cannot run on NixOS until #91 lands.
  • System RAM (>32 GB recommended, 64 GB+ ideal): The OS caps NPU-pinned memory near half of system RAM (~15.6 GB on a 32 GB PC). Because the 20B weights and KV cache occupy ~14 GB+, use a machine with >32 GB (ideally 64 GB+) of RAM, or see unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF on the Qwen page for an open NPU + CPU MoE option.
  • Safeguard variant: gpt-oss-sg:20b runs OpenAI’s policy-classification and safety-moderation fine-tune (openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) with identical OFLM_GPTOSS_ENGINE=closed and /set r-eff controls.
